name: Itself
overview: Scripture emphasizes the absolute sufficiency and authority of God's Word itself, commanding believers neither to add to nor diminish from it, as seen in Deuteronomy 4:2 and 12:32. The Word is portrayed as perfect and life-giving, sustaining man beyond physical needs (Deuteronomy 8:3) and converting the soul (Psalms 19:7). Meditation on and internalization of God's Word leads to wisdom, obedience, and spiritual victory, as encouraged in Joshua 1:8 and Psalms 119:11.
